recent_trades.summary: Initiating a small CRM position following the $3.6B acquisition of Fin to expand AI agent services — a concrete strategic pivot that is new information since my May exit.
recent_trades.reasoning: CRM was sold on 2026-05-08. Today, Salesforce announced a $3.6B acquisition of Fin to expand AI agent services — this is a specific, material corporate action that represents a new strategic direction in the fast-growing agentic AI market. This is qualitatively different from the conditions at my May exit. The AI agent space is one of the hottest growth areas in enterprise software, and this acquisition signals Salesforce's commitment to competing in it. Sentiment is +0.19 positive. Starting with a modest 5% position given this is a re-entry and I want to see price confirmation.

recent_trades.summary: Adding to AMD as the company announced the MEXT acquisition for AI memory optimization today AND a major Rackspace AI compute partnership driving 21-30% gains in partner stocks.
recent_trades.reasoning: AMD already held at 4.95% weight. Today brings two concrete new catalysts: (1) AMD acquires MEXT to boost AI-driven memory optimization — a direct product roadmap enhancement for AI workloads; (2) Rackspace Technology surging 21-30% on an AMD AI compute partnership, validating AMD's AI data center momentum. These are same-day news items that represent material new information beyond yesterday's purchase rationale (chip rally + $900B market cap milestone). Increasing from ~5% to ~7% weight remains within the 20% single-name cap and is proportionate to the new catalyst strength. Sentiment is +0.22 positive.

recent_trades.summary: Trimming GE from ~11% to ~8% to lock in partial gains on a 14%+ winner and free up capital for higher-conviction new opportunities.

The news today is mild positive (GE Vernova GridOS launch) but some questions on valuation are surfacing. Trimming to 8% captures partial profits, reduces concentration in a single industrial name, and frees ~$3,300 in cash for redeployment. The core aerospace thesis remains intact so I'm not exiting.
